notes.text: Band 11 (line 28), band 12 (lines 29-32, the 'Въ женскомъ | Въ мужскомъ произношеніи' captions and parallel text) are now adjacent Other bands; the editor may want them as one band, and may fold in the '27.' heading band 10.
Colophon 'Записано на р. Острокаменной отъ чукчанки Кутјэут', indented and left-aligned, not centred; left as MainZone-P (the rule's reading of the indent); editor may prefer Other.
